title: Daande Ummiinde e Ɓooygol
intro: Haala muñal e yurmeende Alla nde alaa keerol ina feeñi e nder Quraan. Nelaaɗo yelaama wuro mawngo, kono yimɓe maɓɓe njaɓaani jeertinaango, calii goonga. E nder mettere, ooɗoo ruuhu dilli — tan ko ngam jarribeede e maayo ɓuuɓngo, ɓuuɓna ɗum e nder niɓɓere ɓurnde niɓɓiɗde. Gila e reedu niɓɓere, ñaagunde lesɗikinnde ummii, Yurmeende jaabtii. Hol oo ruuhu yaltuɗo wayliima, mo yimɓe mum ngonata gooŋɗinɓe ko ɓuri teemedere ujunere ?
clues: Mi neldaama jeertinoowo wuro mawngo ngo hoɗɓe mum njippii e laawol iimanaagal.
Mi noddii leñol am e goonga laabi keewɗi, kono ɓe njaɓaani, ɓe njaɓaani nelal am.
Mi ummii e maɓɓe e mettere hade am heɓde yamiroore, mi fayi to maayo udditiingo.
Henndu mawndu ummii, mi werlaa e maayo — ndeen tagoore mawnde e maayo ɓuuɓni mi fof.
E nder laabi niɓɓere — luggiɗnde maayo, reedu tagoore ndee, e ŋoral maayo luggiɗngo — miɗo wulla: ‘Alaa laamɗo so wonaa aan; teddungal wonande ma; Miɗo jeyaa e tooñooɓe.”
Alla hisni kam e lugge, nde ngartu mi, ko ina tolnoo e teemedere ujunere e leñol am njaɓɓorii goonga.

arabic: فَلَوْلَا كَانَتْ قَرْيَةٌ ءَامَنَتْ فَنَفَعَهَآ إِيمَـٰنُهَآ إِلَّا قَوْمَ يُونُسَ لَمَّآ ءَامَنُوا۟ كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْخِزْىِ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَمَتَّعْنَـٰهُمْ إِلَىٰ حِينٍۢ
verse: Then has there not been a [single] city that believed so its faith benefited it except the people of Jonah? When they believed, We removed from them the punishment of disgrace in worldly life and gave them enjoyment [i.e., provision] for a time. (10:98)
